paper_scope: training CERM surrogate loss on imbalanced CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 at tau 0.05 and 0.1
paired_endpoint_difference: SCENT minus SOX; lower is better
verified_if: every setting is either superior (bootstrap upper bound below zero) or equivalent (bootstrap interval inside +/-0.002)
falsified_if: any setting has bootstrap lower bound above +0.002
blocked_if: the complete protocol runs but at least one setting remains statistically unresolved
